title: CITU Keralam State conference concludes, re-elects T.P. Ramakrishnan as president

ai.summary: CITU Keralam re-elected T.P. Ramakrishnan as president, planning protests against UDF government's employee transfer policy and Labour Codes repeal.

facts.claim: CITU Keralam State conference re-elected T.P. Ramakrishnan as president
facts.quote: The 16th State conference of the Centre of Indian Trade Unions (CITU), which concluded here on Monday, re-elected T.P. Ramakrishnan as State president and K.K. Jayachandran as general secretary.

facts.claim: CITU Keralam plans protests against UDF government's employee transfer policy
facts.quote: Mr. Ramakrishnan said the CITU would launch a series of protests against what he termed the United Democratic Front (UDF) government’s unilateral move to transfer en masse employees of various government departments and State-run Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

facts.claim: CITU Keralam plans to repeal Labour Codes
facts.quote: Mr. Ramakrishnan also spoke of the plans to line workers from Keralam for a massive march from Ramlila Maidan to Parliament on December 1, demanding the repeal of the Labour Codes.
